Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

IS : 9261 -- 1979 




Indian Standard 



(Reaffirmed -2012) 



SYMBOLIZATION OF CONTROL POSITIONS FOR 
TIMEKEEPING INSTRUMENTS 



1. Scope — Specifies symbols to be utilized for representing tiie different positions in which 
timekeeping instruments are placed for testing and control purposes. 

1.1 It applies mainly to wrist watches and pocket watches. It may also be used for other types of 
timekeeping instruments. 

2. Designations and Syntbols for Control Positions 

2.1 Vertical Positions 

Position Designation 




Hour 3 Up 



Symbol 



3 U 



if) 




Hour 6 Up 



6 U 




Hour 9 Up 



9 U 



1? 




Hour 12 Up 



12 U 



For any other vertical position, apart from the ones indicated above, the position shall be 
designated on similar basis. 

Example: 

Hour 4 Up : 4 U

2.3 Inclined Positions ^ For any inclined position, it &hali be designated witl> the addition of the 
angle attained with the vertical followed by the letter 'B' or 'F' indicating the inclination towards 
back or front, to the normal designation for vertical position ( see 2.1 ). 



Examples: 



Position 




Designation 

Hour 12 Up 
+ 30^ Front 



Symbol 
12 U 30*? F 






Hour 3 Up 
+ 45^ Bacl« 



3 U 45*^ B 



3. Designation of Positions for Timekeeping Instruments Without Conventional Dials and 
for Movements — For timel^eeping instruments without the conventional dials ( numerical or digital 
Indicating types ), or for movements, the designation shall be made by considering as having fitted 
imaginary dials, with hours 9 and 3 situated at left and right positions respectively In the normal 
position of usage. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

in the preparation of this standard, assistance has been derived from the following 
publications: 

ISO 3158-1976 Timel(eeping instruments — Symbolization of control positions. 

NF S 81 - 505 : 1974 Timekeeping instruments — Symbolization of control positions.
